zh.text: 要删文件。先看清楚有什么可删的，不能直接动手。

en.text: Files need deleting. First see what is actually there — never act blind.

zh.text: 请求工具列出构建目录。

en.text: Request the tool to list the build directories.

zh.text:
dist/  14 files · 3.2 MB
build/  7 files · 1.1 MB

en.text:
dist/  14 files · 3.2 MB
build/  7 files · 1.1 MB

zh.text: 目标明确了。删除属于危险动作，这次调用会先被 harness 的确认闸门拦下来。

en.text: Target confirmed. Deletion is dangerous, so this call goes through the harness confirmation gate first.

zh.text: 请求删除两个构建目录（只是文本，不会真实执行）。

en.text: Request deletion of both build directories (text only — nothing is executed).

zh.text:
[harness] rm -rf 命中确认规则 → 等待人工批准 → 已批准
21 files deleted (4.3 MB)

en.text:
[harness] rm -rf matched a confirmation rule → awaiting approval → approved
21 files deleted (4.3 MB)

zh.text: 停止原因：任务完成。已清理 dist/ 与 build/（21 个文件、4.3 MB）；删除动作先经过 harness 的确认闸门，模型自始至终只发出请求。

en.text: Stop reason: task complete. dist/ and build/ are cleaned (21 files, 4.3 MB); the deletion passed the harness confirmation gate and the model only ever issued requests.

zh.text: 请求读取构建清单。

en.text: Request the build manifest.

zh.text: command failed: dist/manifest.json: No such file or directory

en.text: command failed: dist/manifest.json: No such file or directory

zh.text: 工具失败了。清单不在预期路径——先列出 dist/ 的实际内容，再决定下一步，而不是重复同样的请求。

en.text: The tool failed. The manifest is not where expected — list what is really in dist/ before deciding, instead of repeating the same request.

zh.text: 改用列目录的请求（明确的恢复动作）。

en.text: Switch to a directory listing request (the explicit recovery action).

zh.text: dist/  app.js  style.css

en.text: dist/  app.js  style.css

zh.text: 停止原因：已恢复并完成。工具失败后先诊断、再换动作重试——失败被明确展示，没有被当成成功。

en.text: Stop reason: recovered and complete. After the tool failure the loop diagnosed, then retried with a different action — the failure is shown, never disguised as success.

zh.text: 第 1 轮决策：先探索目录结构。

en.text: Decision round 1: explore the directory structure.

zh.text: 请求列出目录。

en.text: Request the directory listing.

zh.text: ./dist ./build ./logs ./src …

en.text: ./dist ./build ./logs ./src …

zh.text: 第 2 轮决策：范围太大，继续细分。

en.text: Decision round 2: too broad — keep narrowing.

zh.text: 请求列出日志文件。

en.text: Request the log file listing.

zh.text: found 12 files

en.text: found 12 files

zh.text: 第 3 轮决策：还想继续读取更多内容……

en.text: Decision round 3: still wants to read more…

zh.text: 停止原因：步数预算耗尽（示意上限 8 个事件）。循环直接停止，不假装生成了答案——预算管理就是给它一个确定的终止条件。

en.text: Stop reason: the step budget is exhausted (illustrative limit of 8 events). The loop simply stops and does not pretend an answer exists — budgeting is what gives it a deterministic end.

zh.title: Agent Loop 分步实验
zh.question: 当工具失败或预算耗尽时，循环如何恢复或停下来？
zh.assumption: 预设教学轨迹：决策说明是作者写的讲解，不是模型的内部思考；命令只是文本，不会真实执行，也不触发任何工具。
zh.observe: 观察：三种序列分别靠什么结束？失败在哪一步被明确展示出来？
zh.footerNote: 示意数据 · 模型假设 · 对应来源

en.title: Agent loop, step by step
en.question: When a tool fails or the budget runs out, how does the loop recover or stop?
en.assumption: Preset teaching trace: the decision notes are the author's explanations, not a model's inner thought; the commands are inert text — nothing is executed and no tool is invoked.
en.observe: Observe: what ends each of the three sequences? Where does the failure show up explicitly?
